data.title: Palm Hills
data.about:
Villas with five bedrooms in Palm Hills. 

Emaar collaborated with world-renowned designer Elie Saab to create the interiors of these spacious villas. There are two different sets to pick from Bloom and Flora.

location_tile.title: The Dubai Hills Estate is located off Al Marabea Street
location_tile.description:
Dubai Hills Estate extends all the way to Umm Suqeim Road, making it easy to get to Downtown Dubai and other commercial, retail, and tourism areas. Because of the development’s excellent location between Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, you can access Dubai International Airport and other emirates swiftly and simply. Dubai Hills Estate is close to Emaar’s Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club and Downtown Dubai.

  • 10 mins to Dubai Marina
  • 10 mins to Downtown Dubai
  • 12 mins to Jumeirah Beach
  • 20 mins to Dubai International Airport
